query:
UPDATE orders o
               SET o.actual_amount = (
                   SELECT SUM(od.actual_amount)
                   FROM order_details od
                   WHERE od.order_id = o.id
               ),
               o.total_amount = (
                   SELECT SUM(od.total_amount)
                   FROM order_details od
                   WHERE od.order_id = o.id
               ),
               o.discount_amount = (
                   SELECT SUM(od.total_amount - od.actual_amount)
                   FROM order_details od
                   WHERE od.order_id = o.id
               ),
               o.order_status = 'STOCKED',
               o.stocked_by = ? 
               WHERE o.id = ?
